title: Dev server binds 0.0.0.0
evidence: app.py:147 app.run(host="0.0.0.0", ...) exposes the Flask dev server on all interfaces
suggestion: Bind 127.0.0.1 for local dev, or front with a production WSGI server

title: GET /books has no pagination
evidence: app.py:91-100 returns the full collection unconditionally
suggestion: Optional: add ?limit/?offset — not required by TASK.md

title: ?author filter is exact-match only
evidence: app.py:95-96 uses `WHERE author = ?` — no substring/case-insensitive match
suggestion: Optional: LIKE match if partial filtering is desired; spec only asks for a filter
